mixed.media: signaling only; no SFU/TURN media generated

redisRecovery.name: redis-noeviction-overflow-and-recovery
redisRecovery.scope: isolated Redis OOM + actual search command and automatic recovery; not client outbox admission control

load.disconnectClassification: The raw report labels 5000 io client disconnect events with the last phase: these are explicit generator cleanup calls in finally. The other two disconnects are planned offline fixtures.

android.serverUsed: existing backend; local bulk load used only isolated services
android.failureInjection: only one designated message forced to OutboxFullError in dev JS; production source and all stored outbox rows unchanged; original function restored
android.coldRestart: Maestro passed after confirmed empty pidof; chat and test text visible after cold launch

limits: Single laptop shares CPU/memory between generator, backend, database and emulator.
Synthetic short chat messages; load clients do not carry real E2EE chat keys. Two-device testing uses the ordinary client message path; wire encryption was not separately inspected.
Calls exercise signaling/tokens/heartbeats; no generated SFU/TURN media.
Mixed soak is approximately one minute, not a long-running server reliability test.
Most load clients advertise welcome_delta; one legacy client checks snapshot compatibility.
Outbox limit covers metadata, not referenced media file sizes; pre-existing rows are not evicted.
A burst of 5000 random searches still takes up to about 17 seconds on the shared local host.
Random pairs, reconnect timers and call registries still have one backend owner; multi-instance failover is not implemented.
